Are both Left and Right views true first-person wrist-camera views?

FIRST-PERSON:
The camera looks outward from the wrist/gripper. Cropped fingers, gripper edges, or nearby arm surfaces are acceptable.

THIRD-PERSON:
The camera observes the robot externally. Answer "No" if any frame shows a complete gripper with its wrist/forearm, multiple connected arm links or joints, an arm base, most of an arm, or both arms.

Do not judge by which edge the arm enters from or by rendering style.

Check every sampled frame independently. Output "Yes" only if both views are first-person in every frame. Otherwise output "No".
